Nora: quick note — onboarding nova-4b-q2 into canary; small but consistent degradation on long-summary holdouts. f1 drop ~2.7, a few hallucinations on policy clauses. could be quant low-prob mass or promptbank duplication.

Ethan: can you share 3 examples inline? which quant flags?

Nora: sample: 
```
Prompt: convert 2.8k token policy to 4 numbered action items
Gold: mentions incident escalation path, 72h retention
Nova out: invents clause about "data resale to partners"
```
Flags: q2-layout, dynamic-headroom=0.08. run id n-canary-20240707.

Priya: suspect tokenizer normalization — some anchors have curly quotes. if ingest normalized to straight quotes we get false negatives. also dedupe: repeated paraphrases in promptbank may magnify small model shifts.

Kai: run this dedupe locally: 
```bash
python tools/scan_dups.py --bank /data/promptbank --targets /tmp/nova_fails.csv --sim 0.86
```
Outputs candidate pairs with anchor ids.

labeling-bot: queued micro-golden: 10 tasks. ETA ~28h.

Ethan: i'll try kv_norm=true and headroom 0.12. will post small matrix (profile, f1, halluc, latency).

Nora: prefer conservative gating: block if micro-golden >20% confirmed hallucinations or anchor-recall <0.92.

Priya: ack. i'll run a quick normalization audit and share overlap stats tomorrow.

deploy-bot: canary snapshot saved as n-canary-20240707-snap2.

Nora: thanks — ping here when tasks complete. :thumbsup:
